name: aws-serverless-api-lite-terraform
description: Free Terraform starter: API Gateway + Lambda (Node.js 24, TypeScript) with validation, structured logging, tracing and tests.

scripts.plan: npm run bundle && terraform -chdir=infra init -input=false && terraform -chdir=infra plan
scripts.deploy: npm run bundle && terraform -chdir=infra init -input=false && terraform -chdir=infra apply -auto-approve
scripts.destroy: npm run bundle && terraform -chdir=infra init -input=false && terraform -chdir=infra destroy
